subject: REDEFINES clause
notes: kb/Work PB1281 (wave 1020 H). SR6 (cite.py --check 13.18.44.3 "Data-name-2 shall not be qualified" OK §13.18.44.3 6)). The CST used to hand the binder dataReference().GetText(), so `REDEFINES A OF G` resolved the glued word AOFG: COBOL1654 citing SR4/SR7/SR10 when no AOFG existed, and a SILENT bind to an unrelated item AOFG when one did (sr6_aofg printed WXYZ). DataDescriptionCst.RedefinesTarget now returns the written reference and DataBinder.RedefinesDataName2 refuses a qualifier as COBOL2915 (naming SR6 and quoting NOTE 1) and resolves the BASE data-name only, so nothing cascades; negative pb1281-redefines-qualified keeps an AOFG item declared to prove the silent bind is gone. NOTE 1's placement reading for a non-unique data-name-2 is pinned by 85/pb1281_redefines_data_name_2_bare (Z REDEFINES X inside H overlays H's X: CD). retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Frontend/Cst/DataDescriptionCst.cs#RedefinesTargetName (kb/Work PB1281 replaced the glued-text accessor RedefinesTargetName with RedefinesTarget, which hands the binder the written dataReference)
